# NivoraFi — Complete Protocol & Technical Reference (llms-full.txt)

> NivoraFi is a non-custodial fixed-yield and yield tokenization Automated Market Maker (AMM) protocol built natively in `#![no_std]` Soroban Rust on the Stellar network.

- **Live App:** https://www.nivorafi.xyz
- **X (Twitter):** https://x.com/NivoraFi
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/NivoraFi/nivorafi
- **Concise Index:** https://www.nivorafi.xyz/llms.txt

---

## 1. Executive Summary

NivoraFi brings Pendle-style yield tokenization to Stellar Soroban. Users deposit yield-bearing Stellar assets (such as Blend Protocol `bUSDC` and `XLM` vaults) into a Standardized Yield (`SY`) wrapper and split them into two separate SEP-41 tokens with a fixed maturity date:

1. **Principal Token (`PT`):** Represents the underlying principal redeemable 1:1 for `SY` at maturity. Before maturity, `PT` trades at a discount to `1 SY` (e.g., `0.975 SY`), allowing buyers to lock in a deterministic **Fixed APY** until maturity.
2. **Yield Token (`YT`):** Represents the right to claim 100% of the variable yield generated by the underlying `SY` from the time of minting until maturity, plus accrued `bRate` yield checkpoints. `YT` gives traders leveraged exposure to variable APY movements without holding the full principal.

---

## 2. Core Architecture & Mathematics

### Standardized Yield (`SY`)
- Soroban SEP-41 compatible vault wrapper (`sy_blend_wrapper`) normalizing yield-bearing positions (e.g., Blend `bUSDC`) to a uniform exchange rate (`bRate`).

### Time-Decaying Log-Normal AMM (`yield_pool`)
- **Single-Pool Design:** `PT` and `SY` share one unified liquidity pool. `YT` trades are routed through the same `PT/SY` pool via **2-step Picard iteration flash swaps**, eliminating liquidity fragmentation between `PT` and `YT` orderbooks.
- **Time-Decay Curve:** As `time_to_maturity -> 0`, the AMM curve flattens toward a `1:1` constant-sum invariant so `PT` naturally converges to `1 SY` at maturity with minimal impermanent loss for liquidity providers (`LP-PT-SY`).
- **Implied Fixed APY:** Derived directly from the market `PT/SY` exchange rate and remaining seconds to maturity (`365 days` annualized).

### 1-Click Atomic Rollover
- Upon maturity, holders of matured `PT` can redeem `1:1` for underlying `SY`/`USDC`, or execute a **1-click atomic rollover** migrating matured `PT` directly into a fresh active maturity pool (`PT` or `LP`) in a single Soroban transaction.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What is NivoraFi?
NivoraFi is a non-custodial fixed-yield and yield tokenization AMM protocol built natively on Stellar Soroban. It separates yield-bearing Stellar assets into Principal Tokens (PT) and Yield Tokens (YT) so users can lock in fixed APY, trade variable yield, or provide liquidity with low impermanent loss.

### How do Principal Tokens (PT) and Yield Tokens (YT) work on Stellar?
Depositing a yield-bearing asset such as Blend bUSDC mints 1 PT and 1 YT per unit of Standardized Yield (SY). PT trades at a discount before maturity and redeems 1:1 for SY at maturity, delivering a fixed return. YT receives all variable lending yield generated until maturity.

### How does NivoraFi avoid splitting liquidity between PT and YT?
NivoraFi uses a single unified PT/SY time-decaying log-normal AMM pool. Yield Token (YT) buys and sells are executed atomically via 2-step Picard iteration flash swaps against the PT/SY pool, concentrating all depth in one pool.

### What happens when a market reaches maturity?
At maturity, PT is redeemable 1:1 for the underlying SY asset, YT stops accruing new yield (any previously accrued yield remains claimable), and users can atomically roll over matured PT into a new active maturity pool in one click.
